_comment: Hardcoded build tags. Single source of truth: the backend validates against it (backend/security.js) and the frontend renders it (frontend/src/utils/buildTags.ts). Tag ids are stored as a comma-separated list in builds.tags - never rename an id, only labels and descriptions.

tags.label: Tech Rush
tags.description: Research is the top priority from day one.

tags.label: Early Rush
tags.description: Attacks a neighbor within the first ~30 years.

tags.label: Warmonger
tags.description: Expands mainly through conquest for the whole game.

tags.label: Peaceful
tags.description: Avoids offensive wars; grows through diplomacy, trade and development.

tags.label: Wide (Many Planets)
tags.description: Claims as many systems and planets as possible.

tags.label: Strong Early Game
tags.description: Power peaks in the first ~50 years.

tags.label: Late Game Scaling
tags.description: Slow start, becomes dominant in the late game.

tags.label: Min-Max
tags.description: Optimized for raw power above everything else.

tags.label: Roleplay / Story
tags.description: Theme and story first, power second.

tags.label: Meme / Gimmick
tags.description: Built around an unusual idea, mostly for fun.

tags.label: Grand Admiral Viable
tags.description: Holds up on the highest AI difficulty (Grand Admiral).

tags.label: Crisis Killer
tags.description: Designed to beat end-game crises at high strength (10x-25x).
